greyscale_security: Hi team — we have a bespoke security questionnaire due Friday EOD. They want: rotation proof for our KMS keys, an exported slice of audit logs showing API key usage, and a written repro for a spike we saw (5xx + 401s) tied to billing anomalies. Can you help?

maya_cs: Thanks for the heads-up. Looping in @vikas_solutions for the questionnaire evidence and @kevin_sre for the auth/latency repro. Can you share exact timestamps and any sample requests you correlate to the spike?

greyscale_security: Spike window is 2024-06-17 14:02:00 -> 14:14:00 UTC. We saw ~12% 5xx for generation endpoints and several 401s from one integration key. Sample request ID: req_8b4f2c. Also billing alerted for "unexpected high usage" at 14:10.

vikas_solutions: For the SIG/bespoke evidence we typically provide: 1) KMS rotation artifact (key id + rotation timestamp + KMS export statement), 2) audit log export CSV for the date range, 3) short note describing retention policy & export process. I can produce the artifacts but need confirmation: do they want HSM attestation (Y/N)?

greyscale_security: They requested HSM attestation in the questionnaire (optional), but they'd accept the rotation + log slice first. HSM attestation would be nice-to-have.

kevin_sre: On the 5xx/401s — can you paste the raw request headers (sanitized) and the client IP? Also, was the integration using a rotated API key around that time? 401s often show up if a key was rotated but clients didn't pick up new secret.

greyscale_security: Client IPs: 34.82.10.12 and 34.82.10.18. We rotated the key at 13:59 UTC earlier that day (key id k-42b). We thought we propagated it but maybe not. Headers (sanitized):


-- START LOG SNIPPET --
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.com
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-ID: req_8b4f2c

{"model":"rwd-13b-opt","prompt":"..."}
-- END LOG SNIPPET --

kevin_sre: That matches a common pattern: key rotated at 13:59 but some long-lived containers still had the old secret cached. Two asks: 1) can you run a quick curl from the integration host showing headers + response for req_8b4f2c? 2) we'll pull audit logs for token validation failures. Example repro curl: 

curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-opt","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate

If it returns 401 locally, rotate the secret and retry. If 5xx reproduces, paste the raw response body.

eng_oncall_bot: deploy: service/generator v2024-06-17-1320 rolled out to prod in 2m 12s — build: 0f9a7c3

vikas_solutions: For the audit log slice, we can export the events for the two IPs + request ID window. I'll prepare a CSV and a short cover note showing how to validate the rotation (key id, rotation timestamp, KMS logs showing key_update event). I can also include a snippet of the HSM attestation cert if they want it.

maya_cs: Action items from our side: @vikas — produce rotation artifact + audit log CSV for 2024-06-17 13:50 -> 14:20, include HSM cert sample if available. @kevin_sre — investigate 401 spike root cause and confirm if token caching or env propagation issue; share repro curl results and any SLO/latency anomalies. Greyscale, please run the curl from your integration host and paste results. I'll draft a short response for the questionnaire with proposed attachments and a suggested extension if we can't get HSM cert before Friday.

greyscale_security: Thanks — running curl now, will paste output in ~10m. If we need an extension for HSM attestation, we can ask for one. Prefer to deliver rotation + logs by Friday.

kevin_sre: Noted. I'll also pull token validation traces from our auth service for that window and check for spike in cache misses or backend 502s. If needed we'll open an incident and keep this thread updated.

maya_cs: Great. I'll keep the customer updated and set a follow-up sync for tomorrow AM. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
